pull.title: test: use ipaddress in addr_to_hex
pull.body:
Replace our hand-rolled IPv4/IPv6 parser, with `ipaddress.ip_address(addr).packed.hex()`.

See https://docs.python.org/3/library/ipaddress.html.

events.body:
concept ACK

replacing the naive parser with `ipaddress` is a clear improvement. IPv4-mapped
IPv6 addresses (e.g. `::ffff:192.0.2.1`) were always rejected by the old
parser
